title: QECC-Synth: A Layout Synthesizer for Quantum Error Correction Codes on Sparse Architectures
problem: Quantum Error Correction (QEC) codes require dense qubit connectivity that does not match the sparse qubit coupling graphs of current hardware architectures, and existing QEC circuit compilation approaches either underutilize QEC circuit structure or rely on manual, architecture-specific designs that do not generalize.
motivation: Fault-tolerant quantum computing cannot be achieved without efficient QEC code implementation on real hardware, but the connectivity mismatch between QEC requirements and sparse hardware is a fundamental barrier to scalable FTQC.
method: QECC-Synth automatically arranges quantum error correction circuits on quantum computers with limited qubit connections. It works by inserting extra helper qubits (called ancillas) that relay information between distant qubits, then uses mathematical optimization (MaxSAT—a technique for finding the best solution among many possibilities) to determine the best placement and routing for these helpers. The system systematically explores all the different ways to set up these helpers and selects the combination that works best for a given error-correction pattern and hardware architecture. This approach works for different types of quantum hardware and different error-correction codes (like surface code or color code) without requiring manual customization.
key_novelty: The core idea is treating quantum circuit arrangement on limited-connection hardware as a mathematical optimization problem (MaxSAT) solved over all possible helper-qubit placements, enabling automated solutions that work across hardware types and error-correction patterns.
contributions: Systematic classification of the design space flexibilities of the ancilla bridge technique for QEC circuits
MaxSAT-based formulation of QEC layout synthesis enabling global optimization over ancilla placement
QECC-Synth compiler demonstrating generality across diverse QEC codes and sparse architectures
Significant outperformance of existing QEC compilation methods in circuit quality metrics

metrics.other: significantly outperforms existing methods on QEC circuit quality across diverse QEC codes and hardware architectures (exact numbers not available from abstract)

limitations: MaxSAT formulation may not scale to very large QEC codes or complex architectures due to solver complexity; not discussed.
primary_theme: Automated MaxSAT-based layout synthesis for quantum error correction codes
